notes.title: New Content Update - Pub
notes.notes:
In all:
- Added 22 items
- Added 17 interactions
- Added 1 job
- Added 1 building

New building:
- We added Pub in south-east part of the city. It's perfect place to meet new people or take some drinks.

- We added new 4 types of drinks. You can buy them in Pub or Supermarket (In supermarket you will have to buy whole bottle)

New job:
- Now you can work as Barman in Pub.

The rest are individual changes in other systems.

notes.title: New Content Update - New Job & Fire System
notes.notes:
In all:
- Added 24 items
- Added 30 interactions

New Job:
- Farmer - now you can care about farm animals like cows, horses and pigs!

Fire System:
- We build fire system, which means that if you are not careful during cooking, you can cause a fire

Map:
- More plants


The rest are individual changes in other systems.

notes.title: New Content Update - Small changes for beginners
notes.notes:
In all:
- Added 12 items
- Added 6 interactions


For beginners:
- Added new info about happy in instructions
- Added new info about friends and relations in instructions
- Added small advice about first steps at the beginning of the game at normal difficult level
- Added road signs to market
- Now you can ask NPC for the address of the given place

Teeth system:
- Now if you do not care about the teeth for a long time, you will lose the possibility of having a conversation and you will be forced to visit the dentist. 
- Added dentist cabinet
- Added dental floss
- Added Book: Dentist Tutorial - We plan to add avaible dentist job in future update

Map:
- Now construction site next to market looks more realistic, we added some barriers and construction equipment
- Rebuilding library

NPC:
- Now you can force someone to give you money by knife
- Now you can force someone to date with you by knife

Fishing:
- Added shark
